Key Area Security

Comprehensive security solutions tailored to your specific operational requirements.

Industry Needs

Critical key areas such as large-scale sports events, airports, and judicial departments are typically densely populated, scenario-complex, and concentrated with classified information, facing multiple security risks including drone intrusions, unauthorized personnel movement, and contraband smuggling. Traditional single-method security measures can no longer meet increasingly severe security control requirements. There is an urgent need to establish a comprehensive, smart, efficient, and multi-line coordinated security system to address complex and volatile security challenges. Key area security protection centers on comprehensive, intelligent three-dimensional prevention and control, integrating three core sectors: optoelectronic surveillance, counter-UAV, and smart security screening. Optoelectronic surveillance relies on multi-spectral imaging and laser ranging technologies to achieve full-domain 24/7 precision monitoring and target positioning. Counter-UAV equipment can effectively block unauthorized drone signals and prevent low-altitude security risks. Security screening equipment uses smart detection technology to quickly and accurately inspect personnel and goods, thereby fortifying the security defense line of key areas and ensuring their safe and stable operation.

Solution Center

Airport Security Protection

As a traffic hub, airports cover vast areas and complex scenarios, placing high demands on routine security efficiency for massive passenger flows. This solution utilizes EO monitoring, anti-UAV detection, and high-speed scanning systems (dual-source dual-view) to significantly boost operational capacity while meeting civil aviation safety standards.

VIEW DETAILS

Judicial Sector Security Protection

The judicial sector involves a large amount of classified information and high-risk personnel management, facing hidden dangers such as illegal UAV intrusions for spying or contraband dropping. This solution constructs an all-round three-dimensional prevention and control system, coordinating the deployment of optoelectronic monitoring, UAV prevention, and intelligent security screening terminals to safeguard the core security of judicial premises.

VIEW DETAILS

Large Sports Event Security Protection

Targeted at events and exhibitions with over 10,000 people, addressing pain points such as high personnel density, complex flow control, and low-altitude security blind spots. It integrates anti-UAV early warning with intelligent security terminals to achieve 24/7 panoramic monitoring of venues and efficiently intercept dangerous goods, ensuring the orderly and safe holding of events.

VIEW DETAILS
